sub: on the shore of Issyk-Kul, 5–10 metres from the water
p1: A hot steam room and a separate lounge with large stained-glass windows facing Issyk-Kul. Sunset is the most beautiful time — and right after the steam, a dip in the lake.
p2: The banya is open to guests staying elsewhere, too.
incl: Birch or oak venik — on request
Local white clay ritual — booked in advance
price_notes: Towels and robe — 400 som per person.
Extensions and extra treatments are arranged individually.
Current prices and special terms are discussed personally.
quote: “I highly recommend the banya: jumping into the lake straight from the steam room is pure bliss.”
addr: Tosor village, south shore of Issyk-Kul
